subject.title: ci(release): migrate Discrawl to shared pipeline

question: Should Discrawl adopt `openclaw/release-workflows@v1` as the authorized release trust boundary for its signing, notarization, and Homebrew publishing secrets?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes where privileged release operations execute; this is a repository release-policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness judgment.

options.title: Approve the shared release boundary
options.body: Confirm that the OpenClaw shared workflow and its floating major-version contract are approved for Discrawl's release secrets, then merge after correcting the release-note state.

options.title: Keep local orchestration
options.body: Retain the existing repository-local release flow until the shared workflow is pinned or otherwise approved under Discrawl's release policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared release boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm that the OpenClaw shared workflow and its floating major-version contract are approved for Discrawl's release secrets, then merge after correcting the release-note state.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies steipete as the collaborator carrying the release migration and therefore the best available routing candidate for the release-contract decision.
